report-section-nav.looks: A sticky bar of in-page links to sections further down the page.
report-section-nav.use: Long pages with several named sections, when asked.

fields.links: One per line as Label|#section-id. Each id must exist on the page. Pre-filled with the CyberTipline report's sections: replace them.
fields.label: A name for screen readers, e.g. 'Page sections'.
